entry_item.definition: v. t. To separate, assort; to classify, analyze, distinguish; to discern, discriminate, differentiate; to select the best.

example.definition: To expose, unmask; to distinguish right from wrong.
To distinguish between truth and untruth.

entry_item.definition: distinguer, mettre une différence; 2 discerner, examiner, analyser; 3 choisir, faire choix (c. acc. et c. partie. etc).

distinguer le bien du mal, connaître parfaitement le bon et le mauvais de quelqu'un

entry_item.definition: v.t. To separate. To discern. To differentiate, to make or draw a distinction.
